28 save frames establish float32 conditional peak gain, in-place Array mutation, float64-to-int32 conversion and wrapping PCM16 halfwords; 28 original PCM16 read-conversion slices establish signed 1/32768 readback. File operations are excluded

Eight unshifted mode gestures followed by callback mode comparison establish readiness >128, settings mirrors and SAM-to-SAO Array-save versus Chaos-to-SAM settings-save dispatch, with explicit locked transport exercising real early returns

240 post-read conversion cases establish PCM8/16/24/32 and finite IEEE float32 values, all four alignment offsets, destination bounds and the PCM24 count rounded down to a multiple of four despite partial output writes

15 format-header construction cases establish tags/depths for five formats, fixed byte rate 192000 and alignment 4, and separate 22-byte format plus 2-byte depth write arguments, excluding file operations

24 local loader-admission cases establish signed count >64; 72 dimension assignments establish A/B/shared descriptors, the exact 4096-only 8-by-8 case, truncated other dimensions and marker 1 before payload loading

18 post-conversion loader cases establish fixed 256-byte copies and 64-float cursor advances despite return counts 0..64, while logical progress uses the returned count. Stale scratch bytes can be copied at this boundary

96 complete LED-routine calls establish raw 0/high, 1/low and 2/counter-bit-13 GPIO behavior across display overrides; manufacturer manual cross-check establishes independent/off, Follow and Sync enum labels
748 complete LED-routine calls establish tuning-beacon ratio windows, octave scaling, strict float32 boundaries and retention of the other color pin, with all four prior pin states
432 complete linear-reader cases establish both sides' source addresses, one-subtraction wrap, single-frame reads, exact one-third Focus bypass and fused transformed-coefficient deltas

Working banks, deltas, controls, phases, RNG and sine/Sub words are exact
216 slow-control cases establish Slide's frozen scan anchor, strict float32 0.005 movement threshold and clock-offset cancellation; A measures movement before control clamping, B after clamping

576 parser-boundary cases establish RIFF/WAVE signature status, signed tag/channel handling, format classification and unsupported-PCM code retention, chunk padding/wrap, and EOF/found-chunk termination; supplied post-read buffers and statuses exclude filesystem calls

864 A/B/shared loader cases establish depth/channel-based count and aligned initial seek; three joined A-loader sequences establish scalar copying without downmixing for mono/stereo/three-channel PCM16, with explicit I/O boundaries

140 reader cases establish four-byte lookahead, full-read-only count subtraction, alignment shifting, error returns and overlong output on one-byte-short PCM8/16/24 reads; old scratch bytes are supplied explicitly

32 initial descriptors establish both banks' slot offsets, 8-by-8 dimensions and marker 1; 192 planar comparisons establish exact retained-tail playback through bounded 1024-frame slot storage, including empty descriptors and fractional controls
48 capture start/write/stop sequences establish retained scan offsets after shrink; all subsequent reader addresses/deltas match contiguous physical storage, including 16 cross-slot reads

48 same-machine continuations join unchanged SAM slow controls, an actual SAO mode gesture, unmounted-filesystem and busy-program failure returns, save-time RAM normalization and SAO reader deltas. The scan offset survives; 48 subsequent manual Slide movements clear it. Callback comparison precedes slow-control processing

256 quiet-UI callback prefixes establish operation-byte increment/wrap, recovery command bytes and clearing despite real busy transport returns. The complete SAO sequence also checks 1-to-2-to-0 recovery with all 64 samples processed and existing output/state comparisons passing

960 complete linear-reader cases establish bounded physical playback at lengths 0/1/2/65/1024 and offsets 0/1/1023 on both sides and slots 0/15. Empty Arrays extrapolate with negative fractions and, at full Slide with zero offset, read the preceding physical frame; 16 cases check this access. Combined reader storage requires one leading and 64 trailing guard frames per side within the stated offset contract

Four complete initializer sequences with synthetic advancing tick RAM and real busy transport/DMA returns establish enable clear/set ordering, exact command bytes, delay requests, stale readback copies, zero counter/buffers and five DMA request arguments. Audio-enable becomes 1 before DMA requests and is not conditional on their success

48 complete disabled-audio callbacks establish preserved output buffers, selected DSP state and sample counter while UI/countdowns and capture continue. All 48 eligible captures copy the unchanged analyzer spectrum

200 cold Noise callbacks follow the complete initializer's original enable=1 and counter=0 with explicitly delivered callbacks after busy DMA returns. All output words/state comparisons pass: mute through sample 8193, first finite preclip sample 12005, 3811 unmuted NaN-before-clip frames. This is not physical boot or DMA validation

405 complete WAV wrapper/parser runs with explicit read/seek substitutions establish metadata across formats, channels, chunk order/padding and ignored RIFF lengths; error injection at every I/O boundary propagates status 1/9 immediately. Fourteen edge files establish duplicate replacement, early termination, missing chunks, malformed odd fmt padding, truncated payload acceptance and stale-size reuse after a short chunk header

120 connected parser-to-Array imports with explicit read/seek substitutions establish the first 128 scalar coefficients across PCM8/16/24/32 and float32, 1/2/3 channels, aligned/misaligned payloads, both banks and slots 0/15. Descriptor offsets and suffixes are preserved, dimensions become 2-by-1, and markers become 1. Open/close and actual filesystem/media remain excluded

96 Array saves through explicit file-operation substitutions establish exact finalized PCM16 files, names/flags, in-place normalization and markers for both sides, slots 0/7/15, lengths 0/1/2/64 and four tracked peaks. Reloading those exact bytes through the original parser/loader confirms quantized coefficients, 2-by-1/8-by-8 dimensions, and rejection of saved empty/single-frame files

12 injected payload-write failures establish frame omission with continued RAM normalization and retained save markers; 24 status-zero short writes establish ignored byte counts and header-finalization ordering. Zero-filled gaps and successful file operations are explicit fixture policies, not hardware/media claims

Two save batches establish ordered processing of multiple dirty slots 0/7/15, using one side-wide tracked peak and preserving other markers. The original save/header/finalizer runs until final settings-save dispatch, with file operations explicitly substituted

1020 complete indicator-routine cases establish positive override then A-selection then B-selection then engine display priority, exact four-channel PWM words and override flag. Another 2592 cases establish mode/capture blink pins, linear-mismatch blink and Shift/LF/pulse-countdown auxiliary polarity, including omitted auxiliary writes during positive override

3456 simultaneous Array/shared-button combinations establish A then B then shared dispatch, A-priority Sub/CV selection when both Shifts exceed the threshold, combined mode/capture/LF effects, retained cached modes and persistence mirrors. Another 3456 callbacks with unchanged GPIO establish no redispatch. Contract: stable Shift levels, initial hold counters 0/49/50, inactive capture, no clocks or long-hold actions

200 boot-decision slices establish clock-count bypass and Shift/shared priority for calibration stages 0/1/3 and shortcut flag; 704 stable-input callbacks retain stages 1..11. 176 isolated Shift releases establish A cancellation, B <=9 cancellation and B >9 advance, including eight exact pending calibration-save calls. Twelve separate caller continuations with supplied save returns establish shortcut-exactly-one exit at stage 3, unconditional exit at 12, raw UI/snapshot reset and repeated GPIO-high writes; physical calibration save is excluded

Nine slow and 576 fast calibration-bank updates with persistent RAM establish twelve 64-entry histories, sums, audio polarity and the shared modulo-64 index. 492 endpoint cases establish stages 1/2: strict >60000 upper capture, strict <8000 offset/gain update, inclusive bank-readiness thresholds, ordered slow GPIO writes and fast readiness branches. Sixty cases establish negative/infinite gains and float32 denominator rounding for supplied endpoint spans; physical calibration inputs remain separate

532 pitch-calibration cases establish stages 3..11: inclusive initial window 26..1999, later strict 8100*j +/-1500 windows, reciprocal slopes, unconditional tail extrapolation even on rejection, preserved earlier entries/final slope and GPIO writes. Two persistent sequences join 36 measurement steps, 18 original Shift press/hold/release advances and 972 normal pitch-coordinate reads from the generated tables, stopping before the final calibration flash save

6144 concurrent clock/Array/capture cases join original ISR, full UI and both capture writers with stable held Shifts, holds 0/49/50/51 and explicit analyzer spectra. They establish clock-before-Array ordering, opposite-side selection, threshold-dependent mode/stop decisions, first-write countdown and unsigned stop-length underflow. Two persistent original press/hold/capture sequences reproduce the invalid selected-descriptor length on both sides without injecting capture state or counters

200 complete reader comparisons, including 80 oversized-descriptor cases, establish signed dimension products, wrapping coefficient/byte addresses, fractions and exact deltas with explicit sparse source memory. Twelve prefixes consume descriptors reached by persistent clock/capture-stop sequences without reading escaped addresses; two same-state save scanners select the original dirty slot 0 before file open. Escaped hardware memory contents/faults and later save of a newly dirtied oversized descriptor remain unverified

96 complete callbacks across all three interaction modes join 48 real Array rising edges through two SAM/SAO/Noise/Chaos cycles per side, including held and simultaneous/staggered presses. Exact persistent state and clean/Sub/Noise/Chaos outputs plus tolerance-checked standard outputs establish retained analyzer rates, continued oscillator-mode detectors with explicit callback-entry pole registers, and standard working-bank advancement in SAM using retained SAO deltas. Saved Arrays, periodic Sub mode 5, warm Noise and real busy transport/program returns are explicit fixtures

48 original receive-registration prefixes install the exact half/full/error callbacks and pending DMA arguments. Forty-eight DMA1 circular stream dispatches with explicit status snapshots reach original audio entry at offsets 0/128 and preserve all 32 scalar floating-point registers across three entry patterns. These wrappers therefore do not initialize s22/s23; actual reset/exception context, DMA activation and error paths remain outside the fixture

128 successful software receive starts execute the original DMA routine across eight DMA1 streams, four receive configurations, two protocol values and both prior enable states; exact handle/register/callback state and 256 subsequent half/full audio-entry dispatches preserve all floating-point registers. Physical transfers, W1C behavior and exception entry remain excluded

1600 simultaneous Shift-release/Array-edge combinations establish A-first selection priority, retained counters at Array dispatch, clock-like release admission and capture start/stop after both Shift inputs go low. Two persistent GPIO press/hold sequences reproduce B slot selection and unsigned stop-length underflow without injected counters/capture state or external clocks; held Array inputs do not redispatch

1600 additional simultaneous Shift-release cases include shared CV/interaction edges with every Array-edge/capture combination in the stated SAM contract. They establish targeting from updated retained counters, A priority, Sub/CV 5-to-0 versus interaction 2-to-0 wrap, exact settings mirrors and cleared events. Another 1600 unchanged-GPIO callbacks preserve checked state without redispatch

32 persistent consumed-gesture sequences reach dual capture through actual Shift/Array presses, then exercise every five-input panel snapshot. Any input high retains both gesture-4 latches, held callbacks clamp counters to 1600, all-low clears both counters/latches, and a new shared edge advances interaction rather than Sub/CV. Capture remains active and held shared input does not redispatch; no injected hold/capture state
